note: The site-accessibility gate's ratchet (tools/src/gates/check-site-a11y.ts reads it; nothing generates from it). bandMax is the most built pages the chrome warning band (CHROME_BAND to CHROME_MAX of the page text) may hold: the gate fails when more pages sit in the band, and notes when fewer do, so lower bandMax to the count it names. It only goes down. Edit this file, then run: make gate G=check-site-a11y.
